title: The Lane–Emden and Hénon–Lane–Emden conjectures

result.label: The Lane–Emden and Hénon–Lane–Emden conjectures
result.statement: Resolves the subcritical Lane–Emden conjecture and its weighted Hénon extension. For n ≥ 2, p,q 0 and real A , B , the system - u=|x|^A v^p, - v=|x|^B u^q has no positive entire solution when (n+A)/(p+1)+(n+B)/(q+1) n-2, with solutions continuous at the origin and classical elsewhere. No symmetry or growth assumption is needed. Known radial existence gives the exact existence criterion for n ≥ 3 and A,B -2.
